across at least 3 consecutive reels; any open row may connect.

factor. WILD substitutes; all-WILD combinations pay only as WILD.

prizes.

SCATTER anywhere · 3=241 / 4=481 / 5+=962 coins
Round cap 250,000 · All awards rounded
Virtual coins · No cash-out
